quotes.author: Cavin Ramrup
quotes.text: Cavin Ramrup6 years agoGreat experience with RJ Watercraft rental! Ray and Anthony were awesome. They showed us how to use the Pontoon and helped us maneuver when we were stuck in a sandbar in shallow water. They give you there number in case of emergency to help assist when you're out on the water. Definitely recommend these guys! Will use them again.

quotes.author: Tyler Miller
quotes.text: Tyler Miller6 years agoI went to ride on a jet ski with my cousin for the first time yesterday (Wednesday) and it was amazing!! They first take you on a pontoon to the jet ski area and the ride is gorgeous. It’s like a two for one. The staff is super friendly and informative. I am definitely coming back again and again. If you wanna jet ski come here!!

quotes.author: Brianna Perrotti
quotes.text: Brianna Perrotti8 years agoMy family had so much fun taking a boat rental out and riding the jet skis. We met the owner personally and he ensured hat our experience was what we wanted. Even the guys that get the boat set up are sweet and very helpful. Great customer service.

quotes.author: Ross De Ambrogio
quotes.text: Ross De Ambrogio7 years agoAwesome time! Went with my 13yo daughter. Had a blast from the pontoon boat ride there to the jet ski run. Wish we did more than half hour but will do next time. Worth the money and extremely friendly staff.

quotes.author: Eyal Hubara
quotes.text: Eyal Hubara6 years agoWas fun. Not the safest for covid. Old wave runners. But still recommend. A bit like island time scaduale if you know what I mean. You'll need paitants. But it's the busy time now too.
